create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_1: The Radar Warning Receiver passively detects and report nearby radar sources
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_2: It can be linked to a monitor using datalinks...
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_3: Or by direct contact with the monitor
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_4: The monitor is used to determine the type, threat level, and approximate bearings of nearby radar sources
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_5: The rings of the display the threat level of the contact, not distance
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_6: When a contact first enters the RWR's detection range, this sound will play
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_7: A radar contact on the outer ring indicates that the RWR's sublevel is 100-150%% of the radar's effective range, It can not see the Sublevel
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_8: A radar contact on the Center ring indicates that the sublevel is within range of the radar. The sublevel is now visible
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_9: The RWR will now begin to emit a redstone signal, scaling with the sublevels proximity to the radar, from 1-14
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_10: When the radar locks on to the RWR's sublevel, the contact will move to the inner ring and become red, and the RWR will play this sound
create_radar.ponder.rwr_ponder.text_11: The RWR will also produce a redstone strength of 15
This icon designates a standard radar contact
If a radar shares the same code in its Identification Filter as the RWR's Sublevel, Its icon will be shown in blue.
The Highest threat contact will be highlighted
When a radar locks on to the sublevel, it will be shown in red
create_radar.ponder.sky_radar_ponder.tex: The Sky Radar Mount is an alternative, high power variant of the Radar Bearing
The Radar Contraption is the same between both radar types
And is linked to the Radar Network in the same way as well
The Sky Radar must be above a specific altitude to function properly. This value is currently y = %s
Unlike the normal radar, the Sky Radar cannot detect targets below its horizon
However, there is no upper detection bound, meaning that it can see anything above itself that is within its range
